variants.when: Roughly 2018 and newer models with arrow and OK buttons on the steering wheel, such as the 2021 Navigator
steps: Reset only after the oil and filter have been changed.
Turn the ignition on and use the steering wheel display controls to bring up the main menu in the instrument cluster.
Scroll to Settings, press the right arrow, then scroll to Vehicle.
Press the right arrow again and scroll to Oil Life.
Press and hold OK until the cluster shows Reset Successful and the oil life reads 100%. If it says Not Reset or Reset Cancelled, try again.

variants.when: Newest models with a Settings menu on the screen, such as the 2026 Nautilus
steps: Reset only after the oil and filter have been changed.
Switch the ignition on and open the Settings menu.
Press Vehicle Settings, then Oil Life.
Press and hold OK until the display confirms the reset.

variants.when: Roughly 2007 to 2014 models with SETUP and RESET message center buttons, such as the 2010 MKZ, 2011 MKS and 2012 Navigator
steps: Reset only after the oil and filter have been changed.
Turn the ignition on.
Press and release SETUP until the message center shows OIL LIFE XXX% HOLD RESET = NEW.
Press and hold RESET for about two seconds, then let go. The oil life returns to 100%.
variants.note: Pressing RESET again while OIL LIFE SET TO XXX% is showing lowers the starting value by 10% each time. Leave it at 100% unless you want shorter intervals.

variants.when: Most Lincolns with a tire pressure light, such as the 2009 to 2011 Town Car and the 2011 and 2021 Navigator
steps: Set all four tires to the cold pressure on the driver's door jamb sticker.
Drive for at least two minutes above 20 mph (32 km/h).
The light goes out by itself once the system reads the corrected pressures. There is no reset button.
If the tires are set correctly, the spare is not in use and the light stays on, have a dealer check the system.
variants.note: If the light flashes for about a minute at start-up and then stays on, the system has a fault that adding air will not fix. A temporary spare also keeps the light on until the repaired tire goes back on.

variants.when: Newest models with a tire pressure reset in the touchscreen Settings, such as the 2026 Nautilus
steps: Set all four tires to the cold pressure on the driver's door jamb sticker.
Switch the ignition on and press Settings on the center touchscreen.
Open Vehicle Settings and select Tire Pressure.
Press and hold the reset control until the system confirms the reset.
variants.note: On these models the manual says to run the reset every time a tire is replaced or the pressures are adjusted.

notes: Lincoln uses a calculated oil life reminder, so it never clears itself after an oil change: it has to be reset by hand, and the menu wording changes by model year. On most years the tire pressure light has no reset and goes out after a short drive once the tires are set right; the newest touchscreen models add a reset in Settings.
